parsed.note_claim: The terms "Jewish" and "Jew" are synonyms for "Israelite".
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In the late Second Temple period, the dominant meaning of the word 'Jew' continued to be an ethnic one, in its parallel connotation to the 'People of Israel.'
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states that the term "Jew" holds a "parallel connotation to the 'People of Israel'" and was used alongside "Yisrael" to refer to the same ethnic group.
